name: 12-game
game: a recorded game of «Встань на ответ» (backend/scripts/live_stand_local.py --local --auto --record: the real room with 30 bots, the database in memory, 3 questions of 15 s, boss «clock»), 21.10.2026: media/product/masters/12-game-rec.json (bot names, local tokens only)
projector: cd frontend && GL=mesa xvfb-run … node scripts/stand-local.mjs replay ../deck/cf11/media/product/masters/12-game-rec.json <dir> 1920 1080 (the real projector page frame by frame, 25 fps; ≈ 32 min here): <dir>/stand-1920x1080.mp4

the last seconds, the alarm, the stomp, the floor drops under the wrong answers, ghosts; «Устояли 18 из 30»
